name: Pikasim
description: Anonymous travel eSIMs with instant setup in 190+ countries pay with lightning
extendedDescription:
PikaSim is a privacy-first eSIM provider built for people who value freedom, simplicity, and control over their personal data. Unlike traditional mobile providers that require account creation, identity verification, or long registration forms, PikaSim lets you purchase and activate an eSIM within minutes. There is no signup, no KYC, and no unnecessary collection of personal information. Your eSIM is delivered immediately after payment, allowing you to stay connected wherever you travel without sacrificing your privacy. Whether you're a digital nomad, journalist, Bitcoin user, or simply someone who wants a hassle-free mobile connection, PikaSim makes global connectivity fast and effortless.

Privacy is at the core of everything PikaSim does. The service does not track users, send marketing emails, or sell customer data to advertisers. You can top up your eSIM anonymously at any time using only your ICCID or order number, without logging into an account. PikaSim also supports Bitcoin, Lightning, Monero, USDT, and dozens of other cryptocurrencies through its self-hosted BTCPay Server, ensuring secure payments without third-party processors or unnecessary data sharing. With transparent pricing, no hidden fees, and an infrastructure designed around anonymity, PikaSim offers a modern alternative to traditional telecom services for anyone who believes that internet access should not come at the cost of personal privacy.
